_note: Illustrative approximation of real program structure for a hackathon demo. Figures are synthetic and must not be relied on operationally.

federalPovertyLevel.note: 48 contiguous states and DC. Synthetic figures.

stateMedianIncome._note: Synthetic 4-person State Median Income, scaled by household size using the standard LIHEAP adjustment.

programs.name: Illinois LIHEAP
programs.administeredBy: Illinois Department of Commerce and Economic Opportunity
programs.citation: LIHEAP — federal block grant administered by the State of Illinois

intakeVia.name: Community and Economic Development Association of Cook County (CEDA)
intakeVia.note: Applications are taken by the local community action agency, not the utility.

criteria.text: Household income at or below 200% of the Federal Poverty Level.
Applicant is responsible for paying the home energy costs.

tiers.name: Regular benefit
tiers.text: One-time benefit applied to the energy account, scaled by income and household size.

tiers.name: Crisis / reconnection assistance
tiers.text: Additional emergency assistance where service is disconnected or subject to imminent disconnection.

programs.name: New York HEAP
programs.administeredBy: New York State Office of Temporary and Disability Assistance
programs.citation: LIHEAP — federal block grant administered by New York State as HEAP

intakeVia.name: Local Department of Social Services
intakeVia.note: Regular and emergency HEAP components have separate intake windows.

criteria.text: Household income at or below 60% of State Median Income.
Applicant is responsible for paying the home energy costs.

tiers.name: Regular HEAP benefit
tiers.text: Seasonal benefit credited to the energy account.

tiers.name: Emergency HEAP benefit
tiers.text: Emergency component for households facing loss of heat or heat-related utility service.

programs.name: California LIHEAP
programs.administeredBy: California Department of Community Services and Development
programs.citation: LIHEAP — federal block grant administered by the State of California

intakeVia.name: Local service provider (county community action agency)

criteria.text: Household income at or below 60% of State Median Income.

tiers.name: Home Energy Assistance Program payment
tiers.text: One-time payment credited to the energy account.

tiers.name: Fast Track / crisis assistance
tiers.text: Expedited assistance for households in an energy crisis.

programs.name: Texas CEAP
programs.administeredBy: Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs
programs.citation: LIHEAP — federal block grant administered by Texas as the Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program

criteria.text: Household income at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Level.

tiers.name: CEAP utility assistance
tiers.text: Utility assistance payment made directly to the energy provider.

tiers.name: CEAP crisis component
tiers.text: Crisis component for households facing disconnection or a weather emergency.
